description: Large tree, 20–60 m tall. Leaves thin coriaceous, narrowly oblong-elliptic to elliptic, 8–16(–25) by 3–5(–8.5) cm; apex acuminate or cuspidate; base rounded or cuneate; glabrous on both surfaces; lateral veins 12–15 pairs; tertiary veins and reticulation very prominent; petiole 0.5–1.4 cm long, pulvinous at base. Flower-buds elongate, 4–4.5 cm long; peduncle slender, 4–5 cm long. Tepals 24–32, linear-lanceolate, 3.5–4 cm long yellowish-white or pure white. Fruiting carpels ovoid, 4.5–5.5 by 3–3.5 cm; brown, densely lenticellate.
bibliographicCitation: Aromadendron elegans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 259. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, stem slightly flattened. Leaves elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 10–21 by 4–9 cm, thin-coriaceous, brown when dry; apex cuspidate; base obtuse or acute or sub-oblique; secondary nerves curved, anastomosing; petiole 0.7–1.5 cm. Inflorescences cauline, simple, pendulous; ± 6 cm by 0.5–0.6 cm. ♂ flowers, 80–100 in each collar. Rudimentary ovaries ovoid, 10 in each collar. ♀ flowers broadly ovoid, 5–7 in each collar, embedded in the villous indumentum. Fruits sessile, ellipsoid, 3 by 1.5 cm, on an elongated axis up to 15 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum cuspidatum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 208. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or tree with narrow or cylindrical crown. Bark greyish, thin, finely fissured; wood whitish or yellowish. Leaves elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 8–15 by 2–7 cm, thin, yellowish when dry; apex cuspidate; base acute to obtuse; secondary nerves curved, anastomosed; petiole 0.5–1.5 cm. Inflorescences axillary, simple or once-branched, 13–8 cm long, yellowish, collars ± 3 mm broad. ♂ flowers with broad sporophylls twice as long as the perianth, sterile ovary globose. ♀ flowers globose, 5–8 in each collar. Fruits, sessile, ellipsoid, apex acute or obtuse, yellow or reddish when ripe.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum gnemon. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 205. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree about 10 m high. Inflorescences simple or rarely once-branched, collars remote. Fruits elliptic or ovoid, 2–2.5 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum gnemon gnemon. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 205. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub about 3 m high. Inflorescences once- or few-branched, slender, collars remote. Fruits ellipsoid to ovoid, 1.5 by 1 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum gnemon tenerum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 206. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber. Leaves oblong-lanceolate, 13–16 by 5–5.5 cm, thin-coriaceous, black or brown when dry; apex acuminate; base cuneate; secondary nerves curved; petiole ± 1 cm. [male] and [female] Inflorescences terminal or cauline, much-branched. ♂ spike 2–5 cm, flowers about 30–50. Rudimentary ovaries broadly conical, 6–8 in each collar. ♀ spike 5–8 cm, flowers 6–9 in each collar. Fruits ellipsoid or obovoid, 1.5–2.55 by 1–1.2 cm, pink or dark orange when ripe, stalk slender, 0.5–2 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum latifolium. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 210. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Leaves brown when dry, secondary nerves distinctly anastomosed. Fruits obovoid.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum latifolium funiculare. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 210. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber. Leaves elliptic-oblong, up to 30 by 12 cm, coriaceous, brown when dry; apex acuminate; base acute or obtuse; secondary nerves curved, distinctly anastomosing. Inflorescences often cauline, much-branched. ♂ flowers 30–40 in each collar. Rudimentary ovaries, 8–10 in each collar. ♀ flowers globose, 6 in each collar, embedded in the villous indumentum. Fruits sessile, ellipsoid, 2 by 1.2 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum leptostachyum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 209. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber. Leaves oblong to lanceolate-oblong, coriaceous, brown when dry, 14–16 by 4–5 cm; apex cuspidate; base acute to rounded or sometimes subacute; secondary nerves curved, distinctly anastomosing; petiole ± 1 cm. ♂ Inflorescences axillary, simple, ± 5 by 0.7 cm, sporophylls very short, embedded in the villous amentum; hairs twice as long as the collar. Rudimentary ovaries obliquely ovoid, about 10 in each collar. ♀ inflorescences simple cauline, ± 9 by 1 cm, flowers globose, 8–10 in each collar. Fruits sessile, ellipsoid, 2 by 1.2 cm, surrounded basally by very king long brown hairs.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum macrostachyum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 207. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber. Leaves oblong or lanceolate, about 10 by 4 cm, thin-coriaceous, greyish brown when dry; secondary nerves straight, inconspicuous. Inflorescences cauline, simple, erect. ♂ flowers numerous, 20–30 in each collar. Rudimentary ovaries fusiform, 20–30 in each collar. ♀ flowers 8 in each collar, ovoid, 3 mm long. Fruits sessile, ellipsoid, up to 2 by 1.2 cm, not shining.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum microcarpum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 208. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber. Leaves ovate to oblong-ovate, very variable in size, up to 20 by 12 cm, coriaceous or subcoriaceous, blackish when dry; apex acuminate, base rounded, obtuse or acute; secondary nerves curved; petiole 1–1.5 cm. Inflorescences cauline or terminal, much-branched; male spikes mostly 3 by 0.4 cm. ♂ flowers about 20 in each collar. Rudimentary ovaries ovoid. ♀ flowers 5–7 in each collar. Fruits ellipsoid, 1.5 by 1 cm, red when mature, stalk stout, 0.2 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum montanum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 209. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber. Leaves obovate-oblong or oblong, thin, green when dry, 10–20 by 4–8 cm; apex cuspidate; base cuneate or acute; secondary nerves curved, anastomosing; petiole 0.5–1 cm. Inflorescences axillary, simple, 2–6 cm long. ♂ flowers short, 1.5 mm. Rudimentary ovaries 6–10 in each collar. ♀ flowers 6–10 in each collar. Fruits ellipsoid, acute, ± 2 by 1 cm, longitudinally furrowed, stalk 1–2 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Gnetum tenuifolium. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 207. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Creeping, glabrous, slightly succulent annual. Leaves in a rosette andalong the rooting stems, lanceolate-obovate with coarsely dentate margin; petiole short, flattened. Flowers solitary, axillary on a ca 1 cm long pedicel. Calyx lobes 2–3 mm long, acute. Corolla 5–8 mm long, yellowish-white With violet margin, dorsally split nearly to the base. Stamens 3–5 mm long with acuminate connective. Ovary 1-celled with few ovules; style 3–5 mm. Capsules 5–6 mm diam. ± globular, 2-valved; seeds 2–6.
bibliographicCitation: Goodenia konigsbergeri. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 278. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herbaceous climber to 3 m long; stems climbing, terete, internodes 4–10 cm long, 3–6 mm thick, glabrous, smooth; branches 10–30 cm long, terete to somewhat angular, smooth, glabrous, 1–1.5 mm thick. Leaf-blades lance-ovate to ovate-oblong, 5–11 cm long, 2–4 cm wide (those on main stems attaining up to 17 cm in length and 11 cm in width), the base rounded-truncate to shallowly cordate, or at times cuneate on leaves on branches, gradually attenuate from below the middle to acute or caudate-acuminate apex, membranous to thinly herbaceous; costas 5 or 7 including a slender marginal pair, all separate from the base, the median 3 or 5 convex on lower surface, slender but distinct on upper surface, lateral veinlets many and close together, obliquely ascending, slender, forming fine reticulations that are appreciably obliquely elongate; petioles 15–30 mm long, obtuse on abaxial side, ventrally shallowly channelled, sheathing for 3 to 8 mm; wings 0.5–0.7 mm wide, the apex ending in an acute auricle ca 0.5 mm long; tendrils usually vestigial or none on flowering branches, up to 15 cm long on stems. Umbels borne in few to many leaf axils of branches; peduncles flattened, 1–4 cm long, 1–1.5 mm wide; umbels of both sexes 10- to 30-flowered, the receptacles 2–4 mm across with many small round bracts; umbel rays slender, 5–10 mm in anthesis, elongated to 3 cm with fruits. Staminate perianth fusiform, 5–6 mm long, 2 mm across, gradually tapering to base, suddenly contracted to 3-toothed apex, slenderly 3-nerved, glabrous; apical teeth 3, deltoid, 0.3 mm long, 0.7 mm wide. Stamens 3; filaments connate to ¼ to half way up; anthers ovate 0.7 mm long. Pistillate flowers not known. Berries globose, 7–8 mm in diameter, maturing dark red, 1- to 3-seeded.
bibliographicCitation: Heterosmilax indica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 248. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber; stems apparently herbaceous, terete, glabrous, smooth, laxly branched above, the internodes 5–25 cm long, 2–4 mm thick. Leaves orbicular-cordate to ovate-orbicular, sometimes ovate or ovate-elliptic, 7–25 cm long, 3–20 cm wide, subabruptly contracted to acuminate apex, rounded or shallowly cordate at base, thinly herbaceous to membranous; costas 5 or 7 including a slender marginal pair, separate from the base, prominent on upper surface, highly elevated with narrow wing-like edge on lower surface, lateral veinlets slender, close together, obliquely ascending, forming fine distinct and obliquely elongate reticulations; petioles 15–40 mm long, few-costate, laterally weakly compressed with acute abaxial angle, sheathing for 3–7 mm; wings nearly wanting; tendrils to 25 cm long. Umbels borne at lower few nodes of branches, both sexes 20- to 30-flowered; peduncles strongly flattened, 0.5–4 cm long. Receptacles 4–8 mm thick; rays 1–1.3 cm long. Staminate perianth clavate, 7–9 mm long, attenuate to base, obtuse at mucronate and 3-toothed apex; teeth deltoid-acute, ca 0.3 mm long. Stamens 3; filaments connate to ⅓ or a half way; anthers ovate, 1 mm long. Pistillate flowers not seen. Berries globose to depressed-globose, 7–11 mm across, black at maturity, 1- to 3-seeded.
bibliographicCitation: Heterosmilax pertenuis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 250. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herbaceous climber; stems rather rigid, 3 to 5 m long, slender, smooth, rather densely branching above, internodes 3–10 cm long, 0.7–1.5 mm thick, terete; branches 10–30 cm long. Leaf-blades lance-elliptic to lanceolate, or lance-ovate, 5–13 cm long, 1.5–6 cm wide, shallowly cordate to rounded at base, gradually tapering above to acute apex, herbaceous, thin; costas 5 or 7 including a slender marginal pair, all separate from the base, sharply raised on lower surface, slender but conspicuous on upper surface, lateral veinlets divergent ascending, very slender, forming fine transversely elongated reticulations; petioles 8–25 mm long, slender, subterete to weakly laterally compressed; sheath 2–5 mm long; wings 0.6 mm wide, herbaceous, not auriculate at apex; tendrils slender, 7–15 cm long. Umbels solitary at 1 or 2 basal nodes of branches, both sexes 10- to 22-flowered; peduncles 3–10 cm long, slender; receptacles 1.5–2 mm across; rays 5–10 mm long at anthesis. Staminate perianth ovoid to narrowly ovoid, 5–6 mm long, 2–2.3 mm wide, contracted at base, gradually tapering from above the base to obtuse apex, open with small 6-toothed orifice; teeth ovate-obtuse, the 3 larger ones ca 0.5 mm long, about twice as long as the 3 smaller ones. Stamens 9 to 12, monadelphous; column of filaments 0.8–1 mm long; anthers linear-oblong, 0.8 mm long. Pistillate perianth broadly ellipsoid, 2.8–3 mm long, 2–2.25 mm wide, obtuse at both ends, apex open with 6-toothed orifice, teeth depressed-triangular, the 3 larger teeth ca 0.3 mm long, slightly larger than the 3 smaller ones. Ovary ovoid-globose, 2.5 mm long, 2 mm wide; stigmas 3, 0.5 mm long, recurved. Staminodes 3 (or 4), 1 mm long, needle-like. Berries not known.
bibliographicCitation: Heterosmilax polyandra. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 247. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small or medium-sized tree, to 20 m high. Leaves thin-coriaceous, elliptic orobovate-elliptic, 11–30 by 5.5–10.5 cm; apex broadly acute or rounded; base acute or cuneate; lateral veins 12–14 pairs, slightly raised beneath; glabrous above except the midrib which is covered with scattered hairs; petiole 2.5–4.5 cm long, pulvinate at the base. Flower-buds broadly ovoid, hirsute; peduncle 1–1.5 cm long, stout, glabrous. Tepals white, about 9 in number, outer ones lanceolate-oblong, 2.5–3 by 1–1.2 cm; inner ones slightly narrower and smaller. Gynoecium glabrous; carpels 10–15. Dehis-cing fruiting carpels thick, woody, bifid, about 3 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Kmeria duperreana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 260. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: A shrub, glabrous. Leaves thin coriaceous, lanceolate, 8–26 by 2–8 cm, green beneath. Flowers slightly drooping, fragrant; peduncles 1–2 cm long, curved down-ward. Tepals greenish-white to white, then turning yellowish. No fruiting specimens ever seen; generally propagated by marcotting.
bibliographicCitation: Magnolia coco. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 255. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree. Leaves thin-coriaceous, elliptic-oblong to ovate orlanceolate-oblong, up to 15 by 6 cm; apex obtuse to rounded and often slightly emarginate; base cuneate; lateral veins 10–18 pairs; glabrous on both surfaces; petiole up to 2 cm but usually under 1.5 cm; stipules adnate to the petiole. Flower-buds narrowly ellipsoid-oblong, glabrous; peduncle 1–1.5 cm long, fairly slender, glaucescent, glabrous. Gynoecium ellipsoid; carpels about 11.
bibliographicCitation: Magnolia craibiana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 255. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large tree, to 40 m high. Leaves coriaceous, oblong-elliptic toelliptic, 14–30(–65) by 6–11(–22) cm; apex acute, obtuse or rounded; base broadly cuneate; lateral veins 14–15 pairs, slightly or very prominently raised beneath; glabrous on both surfaces; margin wavy; petiole 3–4.5 cm long; stipules adnate to the petiole. Flower-buds elongate-ellipsoid, 5–6 by 2.5(–3.5) cm, appressed with short greyish hairs; peduncle up to 10 cm long, stout. Tepals cream coloured, sweet-scented, obovate to linear lanceolate, outer ones 5 by 2, inner ones 4.5 by 1 cm. Stamens numerous, arranged in a dense spiral. Fruiting carpels very numerous, forming a cylindric column 8–15 by 2.2–3.5 cm; individual carpels woody, 1.5–2 cm long, shortly beaked; seeds red.
bibliographicCitation: Magnolia henryi. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 253. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large tree, to 20 m tall. Leaves coriaceous, narrowly ellipitc, 18–30 by 8–12 cm; apex gradually or abruptly acute; base broadly cuneate or rounded; lateral veins 15–25 pairs, conspicuous above; petiole 3–5 cm long, densely coated with brownish hairs, pulvinate at the base. Flower-buds elongate 6–6.5 by 2.2–2.5 cm, brownish ferruginous. Peduncle 2.5–3 cm long. Tepals purple or violet-red, thick and succulent, outer ones 6–6.5 by 3 cm, inner ones slightly smaller and narrower. Stamens 1.1–1.5 cm long; produced connective 3 mm long. Fruiting carpels numerous, forming a broadly ovoid mass, 4–5 by 3.5–4 cm; individual carpels 0.5–0.6 cm long, shortly beaked.
bibliographicCitation: Manglietia garretii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 252. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small to medium-sized tree. Leaves oblong-lanceolate to ovate, 15–25(–36) by 4–9(–11) cm. Flower-buds narrowly fusiform, strongly scented. Tepals 8–12. Carpels 10–13 in a gynoecium, glabrous. No fruiting specimens ever seen. A cultigen of probably Malesian (or S. Chinese?) origin; generally propagated by marcotting.
bibliographicCitation: Michelia alba. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 262. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Medium-sized to large tree, to 35 m tall. Leaves oblong-lanceolate to ovate, 10–20(–28) by 4–9(–11) cm; apex acute or acuminate; base acute to rounded; glabrescent or thinly appressed-hairy on both surfaces; lateral veins 16–20 pairs, slightly elevated beneath; petiole 2–4 cm long, appressed-hairy, with stipular scars to above the middle. Flower-buds fusiform, 3–4 cm long; peduncle 1–2 cm long. Tepals orange-yellow, outer ones oblanceolate, 4–4.5 by 1–1.5, inner ones narrower. Stamens 0.8–0.9 cm long. Gynoecium 1.5–2 cm long, glabrous. Fruiting carpels free, laxly arranged in a cluster, 6–9 cm long, often curved; individual carpels woody, ovoid or subglobose, 1–2 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Michelia champaca. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 264. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: A shrub, often profusely branched. Leaves oblong-elliptic, 3–10 by 2–5 cm. Flower-buds broadly ellipsoid or globose, strongly fragrant. Tepals 6, ivory-coloured, only slightly open before falling away.
bibliographicCitation: Michelia figo. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 262. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small to medium-sized tree, to 20 m tall. Leaves oblong or oblong-lanceolate, 9–12(–13.5) by 3–4(–4.5) cm, glaucescent beneath; apex acuminate or shortly caudate; base obtuse or acute; lateral veins 12–13 pairs, inconspicuous above, slightly raised beneath; petiole 1–1 .5(–2) cm long, ferruginous, with stipular scars in lower part. Flower-buds fusiform, about 2.5–3 cm long; spathaceous bracts densely covered with golden yellow silky hairs. Tepals 10–12, white or pale yellow; outer ones oblanceo-late, about 3 cm long; inner ones narrower. Stamens linear, 6–7 mm long. Gynoecium narrowly ellipsoid, densely silky. Fruiting carpels 5 to many in a cluster, 3–7 cm long; individual carpels rounded, flattened.
bibliographicCitation: Michelia floribunda. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 264. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Medium-sized tree, to 25 m tall. Leaves elliptic to broadly ovate-oblong, 17–26(–30) by 11–12(–13) cm; apex obtuse; base rounded or truncate; lateral veins 15–22 pairs, almost parallel; glabrous above, densely greyish-tomentose beneath; petiole 3–3.5 cm long, tomentose, with stipular scars in lower. Flower-buds fusiform, 2.5–3 cm long; spathaceous bract densely sericeous; peduncle 1.2–1.5 cm long. Tepals 12 white to pale yellow, outer ones narrowly obovate, 3 by 1.4 cm; inner ones much narrower. Stamens 5–6 mm long, shortly appendaged. Gynoecium about 1 cm long; carpels 25–28, covered with golden hairs, the stigma black, beaked. Fruiting carpels 3–5 or more in a cluster; individual carpels globose or oblong-ovoid, about 1 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Michelia rajaniana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 262. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large tree, to 40 m high. Terminal bud slender, elongate, silky. Leaves membranous, elliptic-oblong to rhomboidal, 15–22 by 5.5–8 cm; apex acute or acuminate; base cuneate or subrounded; lateral veins 10–15 pairs; glabrous above except the midrib which is covered with adpressed hairs; petiole 2.5–3.5 cm long, scarred below the middle. Flower-buds long-ellipsoid, 2–2.5 by 0.5–0.6 cm; peduncle 1–1.2 cm long; spathaceous bract deltoid, 2–2.5 cm long. Tepals creamy-white, about 15 in number, outer ones narrowly lanceolate, 2.2 by 0.5 cm; inner ones linear, 2 by 0.2 cm. Stamens 7–8 mm long; connective produced above, pointed, 2 mm long. Gynoecium densely covered with greyish short hairs, on a stalk 5–6 mm long. Fruiting syncarp oblong-ovoid, 7 by 4.5 cm; seeds bright red.
bibliographicCitation: Paramichelia baillonii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 266. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 30 m high, 120 cm in girth; crown usually highly attachedand straggling. Bark reddish or dark brown. Leaves of two forms, one on branches linear, terete, decurrent mucronate, ± 0.2 cm; one on terminal shoots, distichous, flattened or feather-like, linear mucronate, 0.3–0.6 cm. Strobili cylindrical up to 1 cm long, on branchlets below the distichous leaves. ♀ flowers solitary, terminal at the end of short branches; receptacle short, thick. Seeds globose with a short mucronate tip, red when mature.</br>The juvenile tree is readily distinguished from Dacrydium elatum by its feather-like leaves.
bibliographicCitation: Podocarpus imbricatus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 201. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 40 m high, 150 cm in girth. Leaves opposite or subopposite, coriaceous, very rigid, elliptic, 3–5 by 1.5–2.5 cm, apex acute; base cuneately narrowed into the very short, thick, slightly flattened petiole. Strobili solitary, cylindrical, 0.7–2 cm long; stamens with large, triangular, acute or acuminate apex. ♀ flowers solitary, axillary, peduncle short, ± 0.5 cm long; receptacle fleshy, 0.8–1.2 cm long. Seeds globose, 1.3–1.5 cm in diam.
bibliographicCitation: Podocarpus motleyi. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 202. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 30 m high, 200 cm in girth. Leaves coriaceous, linear-lanceolate, 7–20 by 1–1.8 cm, apex acute, base cuneate; petiole 0.3–0.7 cm. Strobili greenish yellow, 2–3 cm long, on shortly or sessile peduncles with several short ovate thick scales at the base. ♂ flowers solitary, receptacle ± 0.5 cm on a stalk ± 1cm. Ovule ellipsoid or sub-globose. Seeds elliptic-ovate, somewhat oblique, 1.1–1.3 by 0. 9 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Podocarpus neriifolius. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 199. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree about 8 m high. Leaves coriaceous, erect, oblanceolate orlinear-oblanceolate, 1.5–2.5 by 0.4–0.6 cm, 2.5–7 times as long as broad, apex rounded or obtuse, base very gradually to cuneately narrowed into the short petiole; midrib strongly prominent on the upper surface; petiole ± 0.1 cm. Strobili solitary, yellowish, cylindrical, 1.5–5 cm long, sessile; stamens with triangular or ovate, acute apex. ♀ flowers solitary, receptacle 0.5–1.2 cm on a short stalk, 0.3–0.7 cm. Seeds nearly globose about 0.8 by 0.7 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Podocarpus pilgeri. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 201. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree about 8 m high, 60 cm in girth. Leaves crowded, coriaceous, elliptic-lanceolate or linear-lanceolate, 3–7 by 0.4–0.5 cm, apex acute or mucronate. base cuneate; petiole very short ± 0.2 cm. Strobili yellow, cylindrical, 2–4.5 cm long, sessile, anther-scale triangular-ovate, acute or subacute. ♂ flowers solitary, axillary, receptacle ± 0.5 cm on a short stalk about 0.2 cm. Seeds elliptical, sometimes oblique, 9 by 7 mm with hard bony testa, red when mature.
bibliographicCitation: Podocarpus polystachyus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 200. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree, 10–20 m high, 80–150 cm in girth. Leaves coriaceous, opposite or subopposite, ovate to lanceolate-ovate, 10–18 by 3–5 cm; apex caudate to cuspidate; base acute, obtuse, rounded, or narrowly cuneate into a short petiole. Strobili 3–7 in a fascicle on a short axillary peduncle. Flowers solitary on a terete receptacle. Seeds globose, green or bluish-purple, about 1.5 cm diam. on a thick receptacle or nearly the same size of peduncle, all together 2–4 by 0.2–0.8 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Podocarpus wallichianus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 203. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herb, up to ca 40 cm, erect or prostrate. Leaves spirally arranged tosubopposite, obovate to spathulate, up to 40 by 20 mm, with inconspicuous, up to ca 1 mm long axillary hairs. Capitula 2–30-flowered; usually 1–2(–3) of the 2–8 involucral leaves with an axillary flowering axis. Flowers surrounded by up to ca 5 by 6 mm long bracteoles and inconspicuous hairs. Sepals up to ca 6 by 6 mm, carina up to ca 3 by 2 mm. Petals (4–)5, broadly obovate, up to 7 by 6 mm, yellow. Stamens 7–10(–15); filaments up to 4 mm; anthers 0.2–0.5 by 0.2–0.4 mm. Style up to ca 5 mm with (4–)5 arms. Fruit ovate, ca 4 by 3 mm; operculum as high as the fruit, shining, straw-yellow: seeds oc, 0.5–1.2 mm diam., granulate; testa cells stellulate, with many fine tubercles.
bibliographicCitation: Portulaca oleracea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 269. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Variable herbs. Leaves spirally arranged, obovate to linear, 2–30 mm long, with axillary hairs. Capitula 1–12-flowered. Flowers surrounded by bracteoles and hairs. Sepals up to 8 mm long. Petals 4–6. Stamens (6–)10–75. Style arms 4–8. Fruit ovate, globular or obovate; operculum 1 to ¾ as high as the fruit; seeds–5 testa cells elliptic to stellulate.
bibliographicCitation: Portulaca pilosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 270. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herb, up to ca 30 cm. Leaves linear, up to 25 by 3 mm, with ca 5 mm long axillary hairs. Flowers in each capitulum up to ca 5, flowering successively, each surrounded by up to 10 mm long hairs, and deltoid bracteoles up to 4.7 by 2 mm; transitions between leaves and bracteoles present. Sepals ca 8 mm long, with a very small apical keel. Petals ± obovate, ca 25 mm diam., pink, red, orange or yellow (cultivated in many colours). Stamens ca 40–75; filaments up to ca 6 mm; anthers elliptic, ca 1.4 by 0.3 mm, 2- and 4-celled. Style up to ca 13 mm, with 5–18 arms. Fruity globose, ca 5 mm diam.; operculum ⅔ to ½ as high as the fruit, shining, straw-yellow; seeds ca 11 0.7 mm diam., shining; testa cells ± stellulate, those at the edge of the seed with a central nipple.
bibliographicCitation: Portulaca pilosa grandiflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 271. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Creeping herb, rooting at the nodes; nodes with a whorl ofhairs. Leaves opposite, elliptic to cordate. 2–20 by 0.8–7 mm with ca 5 mm long axillary and interpetiolar hairs. Flowers terminal, 1(–3) on an infundibuliform, profusely hairy stem-apex, at edge with 4, seldom more leaves. Sepals ca 3 mm long. Petals 4, obovate, up to 5 by 4 mm, yellow. Stamens 8 or 12: filaments up to 3.5 mm; anthers ca 0.3 by 0.3 mm. Style up to ca 4 mm with (3–)4(–5) arms. Fruit ± obovate, up to ca 2–3.5 mm; operculum ca ⅔ as high as the fruit, shining, straw-yellow; seeds ∞, 0.8–1 mm diam., dull; testa cells elliptic, radially arranged, the surface either convex or with a pyramidal tubercle
bibliographicCitation: Portulaca quadrifida. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 269. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree; young branches glabrous with tufts of white hairin the leaf axils. Leaves crowded towards ends of the branches, sessile, obovate-spathulate, 12–15 cm long 5–10 cm broad, glabrous to fine velvety hairy; margin entire to dentate or sinuate, with rounded apex. Inflorescences short, 2–4 cm long, few-flowered: peduncle 0.5–1 cm long; bracts small, narrowly triangular. Flowers ca 2 cm long ± glabrous. Calyx lobes narrow, 2–5 mm long (normally). Corolla white tinged with pale violet; tube densely pubescent inside. Style pubescent at base. Drupe globular 1–1.5 cm diam. glabrous, creamy-white (when ripe): 1–2 seeds inside the soft woody stone.
bibliographicCitation: Scaevola taccada. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 279. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climbing or scandent vine 0.6–3 m long; stems slender but rigid, terete, smooth, pale-green, internodes (1.5–)4–15 cm long, 1–2 mm thick. Leaves relatively uniform in shape; blades lanceolate or lance-ovate to subdeltoid-lanceolate, 3–15 cm long, 1–5 cm wide, rounded to subcordate at base, gradually tapering to acute apex, herbaceous to thinly coriaceous, pale-green but not glaucous beneath, costas 7 including a marginal pair, all separate from the base, raised on lower surface, lateral veinlets divergent, straightish, forming fine and not very elongate reticulations; petioles 10–25 mm long, breaking off at very apex, trigonous, striate, sheathing for 3–5 mm from base with narrow (0.3–0.6 mm) wings hardly membranous-margined; tendrils ½ to nearly as long as the leaf. Umbels all single, borne at the first 2 (occasionally only 1) nodes of first-year branches, staminate ones 8- to 22-flowered, pistillate ones 6- to 18-flowered; peduncles 2–5 cm long, slender, hardly compressed; receptacles 1–1.5 mm across; bracteoles lanceolate, less than 1 mm long; rays 0.8–1.5 cm long. Staminate perianth olive-green or pale-red; tepals spreading, outer ones oblanceolate, 2.8–3 mm long, 1–1.2 mm wide, suddenly contracted at short-apiculate apex, inner ones 0.8 mm wide. Stamens 6; filaments 0.6–0.7 mm long; anthers white, globose, 0.5 mm long. Pistillate perianth pale-purple; tepals spreading, ovate-oblong, subacute, outer ones 2.5 mm long, 1 mm wide, inner ones 2 mm long, 0.8 mm wide. Ovary globose, 1.25 mm across; stigmas 3, ca 0.8 mm long, recurved. Staminodes 0–3, filiform, 0.5 mm long. Berries 5–7 mm across, red-purple, 1- or 2-seeded.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax biumbellata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 236. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large climber up to 10 m long; branches stout, terete, striate, withsparse prickles 1.5–5 mm long, internodes subterete, 8–30 cm long, 3–5 mm thick. Leaves large; blades ovate-oval to subdeltoid-ovate, thickly herbaceous to thinly coriaceous, 13–25 cm long, 8–17 cm wide, wholly glabrous, fresh green above, strongly glaucous beneath, rounded to shallowly cordate or emarginate-truncate at base, rather gradually nar-rowed from below the middle to the acute or suddenly short-acuminate apex, costas 5, rarely 7, sharply ridged on lower surface, lateral veinlets slender, spreading, more or less straight, forming loose polygonal reticulations, later becoming obscure; petioles 4–7 cm long, breaking off midway between sheath and blade, obtusely trigonous, often weakly incurved, sheathing portion 25–35 mm long, with obovate-acute herbaceous wings 4–7 mm in width; tendrils on branches, attaining ⅓ to one half the length of blade. Inflorescences (1–)3- to 10-umbellate, axis short but stout, 1-3 cm long, prophyllate at base, almost wholly enclosed in the subtending petiolar sheath; peduncles of umbels verticillate, 1 or 2- to 4-nate at 1 to 3 nodes, 6–10 cm long, divergent, the base with rounded-deltoid bracts ca 6 mm long. Staminate umbels densely 30-to 50-flowered, ca 4 cm across; rays filiform, 10–17 mm long. Staminale perianth 0.6–1 cm long; tepals recurved to reflexed above, outer ones oblong, 1.5 mm wide, obtuse at apex, inner ones linear. Stamens 6, nearly as long as the perianth; filaments slender, 0.8 mm long; anthers lanceolate, 1.5 mm longs. Pistillate umbels 20- to 40-flowered; receptacles globose, 6–8 mm across; rays wiry, up to 25 mm long. Pistillate flowers unknown. Berries globose, 1 cm across, reportedly dark purple at maturity.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax blumei. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 230. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Stems, branches, lower part of inflorescence axis and sheathing partof petiole densely verruculose and usually sparingly prickly; otherwise as in ssp. bracteata.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax bracteata verruculosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 216. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Erect to straggling slender shrub; stems 60–230 cm tall, 3–8 mm thick, teret, smooth; branches obliquely ascending, subterete, faintly striate, smooth, internodes 1.2–5 cm long, 1–3 mm thick. Leaves elliptic to lance-elliptic or narrowly ovate, 6–20 cm long, 2–8 cm wide, cuneate to rather suddenly contracted at base, gradually attenuate above to acute or acuminate apex, thinly coriaceous, glaucous and usually deeply white-powdery beneath, dull to slightly shiny on upper surface, costas 3, occasionally 5 with an additional pair of marginal nerves conspicuous half way up, all separate from the base, prominently elevated on lower surface, lateral veinlets relatively straight, divergent, forming fine but not pronounced reticulations; petioles 8–20 mm long, breaking off at apex, sheathing for 2 to 7 mm from base with narrow herbaceous wings less than 0.5 mm wide; tendrils none. Umbels 2 to 7, close together on distal leafy or leafless branches, single at axil of leaf or leafy bract; receptacles ca 3 mm across; rays 10–18 cm long; the staminate 7- to 30-flowered, the pistillate 5- to 20-flowered. Staminate perianth depressed-globose with 3 obtuse angles, 2–2.5 mm high, 3–3.2 mm across; tepals slightly fleshy, strongly incurved, outer ones orbicular, 1.8–2 mm long, 2–2.5 mm wide, gibbous with incurved thick midnerve, inner ones somewhat rhombic-obovate, 1.5 mm long, 1 mm wide, subacute at apex, cuneate at base, weakly longitudinally folded with inner surface facing outside. Stamens 6; filaments 0.2 mm or less; anthers 0.8 mm long. Pistillate perianth globose, 2–2.2 mm high and as broad; tepals incurved with convex back, outer ones broadly ovate, 1.5–1.8 mm wide, subobtuse at apex, inner ones broadly ovate, subacute at apex, 1 mm wide. Ovary broadly ellipsoid, 2 mm long, 1.5 mm across; stigmas spreading, 0.7 mm long. Staminodes 3, needle-like, 1.2 mm long. Berries globose, 7–9 mm across.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax calophylla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 239. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber 1–5 m long; stems eventually becoming woody, 3–8(–10) mmthick, terete, zigzag, the internodes smooth or with few scattered prickles; branches 20–60 cm long, zigzag to straightish, the internodes 2–7 cm long, 1.5–3 mm thick, weakly angular, smooth or with sparse recurved prickles 1.5–2 mm long. Leaves extremely variable in shape and size; blades basically ovate-orbicular to broadly elliptic, often ovate-elliptic or narrowly elliptic, rarely somewhat depressed-orbicular, 2–12 cm long, 2–8 cm wide, rounded to suddenly contracted at base, rounded to shallowly emarginate at usually mucronate apex, at times rather suddenly attenuate above to subacute apex, coriaceous, glaucous on lower surface: costas 5 or 7 including a slender marginal pair, all separate from the base, slender but distinct on both surfaces, lateral veinlets oblique, rather dense, usually further divided, reticulation distinct, not elongate; petioles 10–15 mm long, trigonous with subacute abaxial angle, breaking at apex, sheathing for 6–10 mm; wings oblong or lance-oblong, membranous, obtuse at apex, 1–2 mm wide; tendrils 0–15 cm long. Inflorescences single umbel borne at 1 to several lower axils of the first-year branch; peduncles 1–4 cm long. Umbels of both sexes (5–20 mm across at anthesis, 10–20-flowered; receptacles 2–3 mm long at anthesis, 5–4 mm long with fruits; rays 1–1.4 cm long, flowers open with young unspread leaves. Staminate perianth campanulate at anthesis, yellow-green, 4.5–5.5 mm long; outer sepals lance-elliptic, recurved at subobtuse apex, 1.8–2.2 mm wide; inner tepals lance-oblong, subobtuse at apex, 1–1.2 mm wide. Stamens not exserted; anthers ellipsoid, 1.5–0.75 mm long on slender filaments, ca 3 mm long. Pistillate perianth 3–4 mm long; tepals patent, lance-ovate to elliptic, subobtuse at apex, the outer ones 1.5–1.8 mm wide, the inner ones 1–1.2 mm wide; ovary ovoid, 2 mm long; stigmas spreading, 1.8 mm long; staminodes 3, subulate-linear, 1–1.3 mm long. Berries globose, 10–12 mm across, maturing red, (1–)2(–3)-seeded; seeds 3–4 mm long, obovate-orbicular, red-purple.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax china. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 233. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Stems and branches 4-angled, dull, the angles either acute andwing-like or obtuse. Staminate perianth 2–2.5 mm long, 1.8–2 mm wide; outer tepals connate to half way, the lobes incurved, deltoid, 1.2–1.5 mm long by 1 mm wide; inner tepals oblanceolate, 1.5 mm long, 0.5 mm wide, adnate to the filament of opposite stamen. Stamens 6; filaments 1 mm long, all connate forming a column; anthers 0.5 mm long; otherwise as in ssp. corbularia.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax corbularia synandra. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 242. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber 60–150 cm long; stems ± straight, terete, usually finely 8- to12-angled or striate, densely branched above, dull, often becoming brown to dark brown, inter-nodes 2–10 cm long, 3–6 mm thick, smooth or with sparse recurved prickles 2–3 mm long; branches 10–25 cm long, 1–2.5 mm thick, angular, sparsely prickly. Leaves elliptic to broadly elliptic, sometimes obovate-elliptic, 2.5–8 cm long, 2–5 cm wide, suddenly contracted to subacute base, rounded or suddenly contracted to short-mucronate apex, herbaceous, not glaucous on either surface; costas 5 to 7 with 2 weak outer pairs, all separate from base, the 3 median costas raised on lower surface with a sharp edge, distinct on upper surface, lateral veinlets spaced, oblique, often further divided, the reticulations rather loose, not elongate; petioles 3–6 mm long, trigonous with subacute abaxial angle, breaking at apex, sheathing for nearly the entire length; wings half-elliptic to semicircular, occasionally somewhat obovate, 2–3 mm wide, membranous; tendrils vestigial to 3 cm long. Inflorescence borne at the lowest axil of the first-year branch; peduncles 1–3 cm long. Umbels of both sexes 10-to 20-flowered; receptacles slightly elongate, 2–3 mm long, 1–1.5 mm thick; rays 1 cm long at anthesis, up to 2.5 cm with fruit; flowers open with well grown leaves. Staminate perianth 3–4 mm long, greenish, spreading; outer tepals oblong, 1.2–1.5 mm wide, subobtuse at apex; inner tepals linear-oblanceolate, 0.5 mm wide, subobtuse at apex. Stamens 6, patent; anthers ellipsoid 0.7 mm long, on slender filaments 3–3.5 mm long. Pistillate perianth 2–2.5 mm long, spreading, greenish; tepals lance-ovate, subacute at apex, outer ones 0.8 mm wide, inner ones 0.5 mm wide. Ovary ellipsoid, 1.5 mm long, 0.8 mm wide; stigmas recurved, 1 mm long; staminodes (4–)6, linear-subulate, 0.9 mm long. Berries 5–7 mm across, maturing red, 1- or 2-seeded.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax davidiana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 232. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber with terete, smooth stems 3–5 mm thick; branches weakly tohardly zigzag, internodes terete, smooth, 1–5 cm long, 1–2 mm thick. Leaf-blades lanceolate, lance-oblong or lance-elliptic or ovate, 5–18 cm long, 2–7 cm wide, suddenly contracted or rounded at base, gradually or abruptly attenuate to acute or acuminate apex, coriaceous, with nerved and thickened margins, often shiny on upper surface, pale or white-powdery on lower surface; costas 5 including a marginal pair, all divided to base, pronounced on upper surface, highly raised on lower surface, the intercostal areas on both sides of midvein much broader than outer areas, lateral veinlets oblique to divergent, some further divided, conspicuous, forming dense and somewhat transversely elongate reticulations; petioles 10–30 mm long, straightish, moderately laterally compressed, breaking off at apex, sheathing for 3–15 mm; wings 0.3–1 mm wide, herbaceous, not auriculate at apex; tendrils slender, 7–15 cm long. Umbels on lower part of branches as well as on distal part of stem; peduncles short and thickish, 1–.9 mm long; receptacles 3–4 mm across; bracteoles ovate-acute, 1–1.7 mm long. Staminate umbels globose with 30 to 60 flowers on filiform rays, 1–2.5 cm long. Pistillate umbels turbinate to hemispherical bearing 10 to 25 flowers on filiform rays, 1–1.5 cm long. Staminate perianth depressed-globose, 2 mm high, 3–3.7 mm across, obtusely trigonous, pale-greenish; tepals free but only slightly open; outer tepals saccate, deeply longitudinally furrowed along median line, transversely widely obovate-orbicular in outline, 3 mm wide; inner tepals ovate, acutish-tipped, 1.5 mm long, 1 mm wide, boat-shaped, dorsally furrowed, strongly incurved. Stamens 6; anthers 0.7 mm long, white, subsessile. Pistillate perianth pale, depressed-globose, 1.5–2 mm high, 3–2.5 mm across; tepals free, incurved, outer ones orbicular or obovate-orbicular, 2 mm wide, rounded at apex, boat-shaped, inner ones obovate, shallowly saccate, 1.5 mm wide. Ovary ellipsoid, 3-furrrowed, ca 2 mm long and Wide; stigmas annulate, 3-lobed; staminodes 3. needle-like, 2 mm long. Berries globose, 5–8 mm in diameter, maturing blue-black, 1- to 3-seeded.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax glabra. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 240. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large climber, more or less glaucous on stems and leaves; stems ±straight, glabrous, the internodes terete, 5–20 cm long, 3.5–8 mm thick, smooth or somewhat roughened, occasionally with sparse prickles 1–2 mm long. Leaves rather invariable in shape; blades ovate-elliptic to oval, 15–25 cm long, 6–17 cm wide, suddenly contracted at base, rather abruptly narrowed to or rounded at shallowly emarginate and mucronulate apex, herbaceous to thinly coriaceous, light-green on upper surface, whitish-green beneath; costas 7, rarely 5, sometimes with an extra weak marginal pair, all separated from base or the median 3 united for 1 to 3 cm above base, highly raised on lower surface, lateral veinlets divergent and close together, some further divided, forming fine and rather uniform reticulations that are conspicuous on both surfaces; petioles 2–5 cm long, subterete, breaking off midway between sheath and blade; sheath 0.7–2 cm long; wings narrowly ovate, 4–13 mm wide, more or less caducous, the apex ending in an obtuse broad auricle; tendrills often developed, (0.2–)8–20 cm long. Umbels 8 to 15, whorled in group of 2 to 4 at 3 to 6 nodes of inflorescence axis; axis arising from leaf axils of upper stems, straight, 6–15 cm long, 2–3 mm thick below, subterete; prophyll ovate, 8 mm long; bracts ovate, 2–3 mm long; peduncles 1.5–6 cm long, patent to spreading. Staminate umbels 22- to 35-flowered, the pistillate ones 10- to 20-flowered; receptacles 3 mm across; rays 5–20 mm long. Staminate perianth yellow-green; tepals recurved at anthesis, outer ones oblong, 4–4.5 mm long, 1–1.2 mm wide, rounded to apex, inner ones linear-lanceolate, 4 mm long, 0.5–0.7 mm wide. Stamens 6. exserted: filaments 4 mm long; anthers oblong, 1.5 mm long. Pistillate perianth 2.5–3 mm long in mature buds. Berries unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax griffithii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 226. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber to 4 m long; stems slender, subterete, 2–4 mm thick, smooth orsparingly prickly, laxly branched above; branches conspicuously angular, striate, strongly bent at nodes thus markedly zigzag, internodes 3–9 cm long, 1–2 mm thick, smooth or sparingly prickly. Leaves always strongly reflexed, lanceolate or lanceolate-oblong to oblong, 9–16 cm long, 3–4.5 cm wide, suddenly contracted to rounded base, gradually tapering from below the middle to the subacute and short-cuspidate apex, thickly herbaceous, pale-green on both surfaces, very dull on upper surface; costas 5 including a weak marginal pair, all divided to base, the median 3 pronounced, convex on lower surface, lateral veinlets obliquely spreading, slender, faint on upper surface, forming weak reticulations; petioles 15–20 mm long, breaking off between apex and sheath, dorsally obtuse; sheath 5–8 mm long; wings ca ½ mm wide, the membranous margins not auriculate at apex; tendrills slender, 8–13 cm long on sterile leaves, vestigial on flowering leaves. Inflorescences borne on lower part of branches, generally bearing 2 umbels on distal part, the common axis slender, 1–3 cm long, spreading, prophyllate at very base; prophyll lance-ovate, 7–9 mm long, gradually tapering to acuminate apex, somewhat brown-tinged, soon disintegrating; peduncles 1–2 cm long, slender. Staminate umbels 18–25 mm across, bearing 18 to 30 flowers. Pistillate umbels 13- to 25-flowered; receptacles ca 3 mm across; rays 5–8 mm long. Staminate perianth 5 mm long; outer tepals oblong, 1 mm wide, obtuse, inner ones linear-oblong, 0.5 mm wide, both recurved at anthesis. Umbels 0.7–1 mm long, oblong, white; filaments ca 5 mm long. Pistillate flowers unknown. Berries (slightly immature) ovoid, 7–9 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax inversa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 220. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber with long, woody, terete stems 4–7 mm thick, up to 5 m long, smooth or rarely sparsely prickly; flowering branches 30–60 cm long, terete or obscurely angular, usually smooth greenish, more or less shiny, internodes 1.5–6 cm long, 2–3 mm thick. Leaves annual or winter-green; blades variable in shape, size and thickness, broadly lanceolate, elliptic or ovate-oblong, 6–15 cm long, 1.5–5(–8) cm wide, herbaceous to thickly membranous, or sometimes thinly coriaceous, fresh green, j usually remaining greenish after being dried, slightly shiny to opaque on upper surface, only slightly paler beneath, contracted to base, gradually or subabruptly narrowed to a very briefly caudate apex; costas 5 including a fairly distinct marginal pair, all separate from base, distinct on upper surface, highly raised often with sharp edge on lower surface, lateral veinlets spreading, ascending or slightly curved upward, some further divided, the reticulation dense and fine, not elongate, distinct on both surfaces; petioles 10–25 mm long, often bent upward above the middle, 3-angular with ? subobtuse abaxial angle, broading off below the middle, sheathing for 4–8 mm; wings narrow, 0.5–0.8 mm Wide, hardly auriculate at tip; tendrils vestigial on flowering branches, those on vegetative branches and stems up to 20 cm. Inflorescences usually 1-umbellate, the axis prophyllate at very base, 3–7 mm long bearing 1 small bract which is usually hidden in the prophyll; prophylls broadly ovate, boat-shaped, 3 mm long, apiculate, persistent; peduncle stout, straight 1–1.5 cm long; umbels of both sexes 1.5–2.5 mm across, 17–40-flowered; rays 1 cm long; receptacles 2–3 mm thick. Staminate perianth recurved at anthesis: outer and inner tepals similar, oblong, obtuse, 3–4 mm long, 1 mm wide; stamens 6; filaments 2.5 mm long; anthers elliptic, 0.5 mm long. Pistillate perianth 1.5–2 mm long; tepals erect to erect-patent, elliptic-ovate, subacute, 0.5–0.7 mm Wide. Ovary ovoid, 2 mm long; stigmas 0.7 mm long; staminodes needle-like 0.7–1 mm long. Berries ellipsoid or globose, 5–7 mm across, yellowish-reddish at maturity; seeds 1 or 2, suborbicular, 4.5 mm in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax lanceifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 225. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber up to 5 m long; stems terete or subterete, striate, sparselyprickly with spreading or antrorse spines 1–3 mm long, rather densely branched, internodes 6–12 cm long, 3–5 mm thick; branches 15–60 cm long, weakly angular, striate, smoother, loosely prickly, internodes 2–6 cm long, 1–3 mm thick. Leaves rather invariable in shape; blades generally elliptic to broadly elliptic, occasionally elliptic-oblanceolate or lance-elliptic, 6–15 cm long, 2–5(–10) cm wide, usually suddenly contracted at both ends, rounded at base, rounded or shallowly emarginate and mucronate at apex, rarely somewhat gradually acute at apex, thin, herbaceous, bright green above, paler beneath, not glaucous, costas 5 or 7 including a marginal pair, the median 3 more pronounced than the remainder, united at base for 3 to 7 mm, highly raised with sharp edge on lower surface, distinct on upper surface, lateral veinlets obliquely spreading, straightish, forming not very elongate, fine reticulations; petioles 6–20 mm long, laterally compressed with sharp dorsal edge, sheathing for 3–5 mm; wings 0.8–1.5 mm wide, thinly membranous, the apex ending in a deltoid auricle ca 1 mm long; tendrils vestigial on flowering leaves, up to 12 cm on sterile leaves and stems. Inflorescences borne on distal part of branches, bearing 1 to 3 umbels; common axis 1–3 cm long; prophylls broadly ovate, acuminate, 4–6 mm long, peduncles spreading 1–2 cm long, slightly compressed; bracts occasionally developing a small blade. Staminate umbels densely 20–45-flowered, 2–3 cm across; rays filiform, 1–1.5 cm long. Pistillate umbels 15–30(–40) -flowered, 2.5–3.7 cm across with filiform rays 1–1.7 cm long. Staminate perianth pale-green, 4.5–5 mm long; outer tepals oblong or oblong-oblanceolate, rounded at apex, 1–1.2 mm wide, inner ones linear-oblong, obtuse, 0.3–0.5 mm wide, both recurved at anthesis. Umbels oblong, 1 mm long; filaments 3–3.5 mm long. Pistillate perianth 3 mm long; outer tepals elliptic, subobtuse, 1.5 mm wide, inner ones elliptic-oblong, 0.75 mm wide, tapering to subobtuse tip, both patent to weakly recurved; ovary ellipsoid, ca 2 mm long, 1 mm thick; stigmas bent downward, nearly 1 mm long; staminodes 3, needle-like, 1.5 mm long. Berries 5–6 mm across, becoming dirty yellow at maturity, 1- or 2-seeded.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax luzonensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 222. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber, 2–6 m long, with terete, hard stems; flowering branches rigid, terete, straight, internodes 4–10 cm long, 2–4 mm thick, smooth or faintly striate. Leaves variable in size and shape; blades broadly ovate, ovate, ovate-oblong or broadly elliptic, 6–27 cm long, 2.5–15 cm wide below the middle, thickly herbaceous to sub-coriaceous, sometimes slightly shiny above, turning dirty green when dried, slightly pale beneath, abruptly contracted or somewhat cuneate at base, gradually or sub-abruptly contracted to a short cuspidate apex; costas 5 including a weak marginal pair, unequally spaced, the median 3 diverging from 7–10 mm above the base, strongly raised on lower surface, the outer pair weak, separated to base, transverse veinlets weak, spreading, forming relatively faint reticulations; petioles 2–5 cm long, obscurely 3-angled, strongly curved and dark coloured in dry state above the middle, jointed at ⅔ from base, sheathing for 7–15 mm from base; sheath wings 0.7–1.5 mm wide, not auriculate at apex; tendrils 8 to 25 cm long, stout. Inflorescences 2- or 3-umbellate; common axis shorter than peduncles, 1–2 cm long, rigid; prophyll broadly ovate, apiculate, subcoriaceous, 4–5 mm long; peduncles spreading, 2–6 cm long, rigid; [ bracts deltoid, 1–2 mm long. Umbels of both sexes 10-30-flowered; pistillate receptacle globose, 3–5 mm in diameter. Staminate perianth 4–5 mm long, white to pale-greenish at anthesis; outer tepals lance-oblong, sub-obtuse, recurved, 1 mm wide, inner ones linear-oblong, 0.5 mm wide. Umbels lanceolate, 0.8–1 mm long; filaments 4 mm long. Pistillate perianth 3.5–4 mm long, slightly recurved to patent at anthesis; outer tepals lance-elliptic, subacute at apex, 1.2 mm wide, inner ones lanceolate, 0.7 mm wide. Ovary narrowly ovoid, 3 mm long; staminodes 3, needle-like, 2 mm long. Berries 1.5–2 cm in diameter, yellowish and turning dark red or purple at maturity, very juicy; seeds 2 or 3, lenticular, 7 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax megacarpa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 217. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Densely branched shrub; stems 3–5 mm thick, weakly zigzag, striate, with rather dense divergent prickles 2–3 mm long; branches 10–30 cm long, zigzag, the internodes 1.5–3 cm long, 2–3 mm thick, conspicuously angular, with prickles ca 2 mm long spreading at right angles. Leaves densely alternate; blades elliptic to broadly elliptic or broadly obovate, 1.5–4.5 cm long, 1–3 cm wide, suddenly contracted or cuncate at base, suddenly contracted above to usually mucronate apex, thickly chartaceous to coriaceous, glaucous beneath; costas 5 or 7 including a weak marginal pair, which usually reach only half way, all separate from the base, strongly convex on lower sur-face, shallowly impressed on upper surface, lateral veinlets oblique, some further divided, pronounced on lower surface, reticulations rather lax, not elongate; petioles short, 3–5 mm long, abaxial edge obtuse, sheathing for nearly whole length; wings 0.8 mm wide, the apex ending in an ovate-acute small auricle; tendrils vestigial or none. Umbels solitary, the pistillate ones 4- to 7-flowered; peduncles of fruiting umbels 1–2.5 cm long; receptacles globular, 1.5 mm across; bracts depressed trigonous to somewhat reniform, short-apiculate, 0.7 mm long; rays 8–12 mm long. Flowers not known. Berries globose, 4–6 mm in diameter, maturing red; seeds usually 2, broadly ellipsoid, 3.5–4 mm long, red-brown.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax micro-china. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 234. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber, stems eventually becoming woody, terete, smooth, rather densely branching, internodes 5–13 cm long, 2–6 mm thick; branches weakly zigzag, internodes obtusely trigonous to subterete, 1–5 cm long, 0.8–2 mm thick. Leaves variable in shape and size; blades lanceolate-ovate to broadly ovate, occasionally ovate-elliptic, 2.5–10 cm, sterile ones sometimes up to 16 cm long, 1–7 cm wide, the base cuneate, rounded or shallowly cordate, gradually tapering from below the middle to acute or subobtuse and mucronate apex, subcoriaceous with more or less recurved nerved margins, strongly glaucous beneath, costas 7 including a marginal pair, all separate from the base, slender but conspicuously raised on both surfaces, lateral veinlets oblique, mostly irregularly divided, some curved upward, forming distinct reticulations of various shape; petioles 10–40 mm long, breaking off at apex, sheathing portion 6–28 mm long, open, 2–7 mm wide; wings herbaceous, 0.8–3 mm wide, recurved, the apex rounded-truncate without distinct auricle; tendrils developing on all sterile leaves and on some (lower-bearing leaves, thickish, rigid, 3–15 cm long. Umbels borne on short branches, the staminate ones densely 15- to 50-flowered, the pistillate ones 3- to 20-flowered; peduncles short, 2–16 mm long, slightly compressed; receptacles 3–5 mm across with many lanceolate bracteoles 2–3 mm long; rays 3–10 mm long. Staminate perianth dark red, spreading; outer tepals ovate-elliptic to ovate-oblong, acute to subacute at apex, 2–2.5 mm long, 1–1.25 mm wide: inner tepals lance-oblong, subacute, 1.5–2 mm long, 0.8–1 mm wide. Stamens 6; filaments 0.2–0.4 mm long; anthers cream-coloured, 0.6 mm long. Pistillate perianth similar to the staminate one but with somewhat narrower and more pointed tepals. Ovary ovoid-ellipsoid, 1.25 mm long, 0.5–0.7 mm wide; staminodes 3, needle-like, 1.2–1.5 mm long. Berries globose to weakly depressed-globose, 5–8 mm in diameter, maturing blue-black, 1- or 2-seeded.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax microphylla elongata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 237. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herbaceous climber; stems slender but rigid, loosely branching, terete, smooth, light green, internodes 2–15 cm long, 1–2 mm thick. Leaves lanceolate, or lance-elliptic to broadly elliptic, 8–15 cm long; 2.5–7 cm wide, contracted or widely cuneate at base, gradually acute or suddenly contracted to acuminate apex, herbaceous to nearly membranous, grass-green on upper surface, pale-green or. lower surface; costas 3, separate from the base or united to 4 mm from base, ridged on lower surface, slender but distinct on upper surface, lateral veinlets divergent, straightish, the reticulations dense and fine, obliquely elongate, the marginal nerves slightly thickened; petioles 7–25 mm long, breaking off at apex often curved and/or twisted, trigonous, sheathing for 3 to 4 mm with very narrow wings ca 0.3 mm wide; tendrils 6–13 cm long, slender, often becoming brownish. Umbels on lower part of branches as well as distal part of stem; peduncles 1–4 cm long, slender, compressed; receptacles 1.5–2.5 mm across; rays 5–10 mm long; staminate umbels 12- to 30-flowered, pistil-late ones 8- to 14-flowered. Staminate perianth yellow-green, campanulate, 3.5–4.2 mm long. 4–5 mm wide, connate, lobed to 2.5 mm from top; outer lobes oblong, 1.5 mm wide, inner lobes half as long as the outer ones, ca 1.2 mm wide, ovate-obtuse, both distinctly 1-nerved, pubescent outside. Stamens 6; filaments compressed, 1 mm long, adnate to the perianth tube for most of the length; anthers ovoid-globose, 0.5 mm long. Pistillate perianth 3.5–4 mm long; tepals free, recurved, outer tepals ovate-elliptic, 3.5–4 mm long, 1–1.3 mm wide, subobtuse at apex, inner tepals linear-oblong, 3–3.5 mm long, 0.25–0.3 mm wide, obtuse at apex. Ovary ovoid, 2.5–3 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, gradually narrowed above to obtuse apex; stigmas 3, recurved, 0.7 mm long. Berries maturing red, 7–9 mm across.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax myosotiflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 243. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large climber; stems 1.5 to 10 m long, ca 1 cm thick; flowering branches terete, dull, striate or slightly zigzag, internodes 5–15 cm long, 4–5 mm thick, smooth or sparsely prickly. Leaves not highly variable in shape; blades oval, ovate-oval or suborbicular, 12–23(–26) cm long, 8–14(–20) cm wide, herbaceous and later becoming thinly coriaceous, pale beneath, abruptly contracted below to a short cuneate base (on sterile branches and stems leaf bases often shallowly cordate), abruptly contracted to rounded or mucronate apex; costas 7 including a slender marginal pair, equally spaced, all diverging near the base, or the median 3 united to 1.3 cm above the base, highly ridged on lower surface with sharp edge, lateral veinlets slender and not pronounced, irregularly divided, forming rather obscure and rough reticulations; petioles 16–30 mm long, triangular, bent upward above the middle, sheathing to 10–13 mm from base; wings ca 1 mm wide, membranous, pointed at apex; tendrils up to 16 cm long. Umbels 1 to 3 on a rather short common axis 1.5–4 cm long, either sex 12-to 40-flowered; prophylls broadly ovate, suddenly acuminate at apex, 4–6 mm long; peduncles of umbels patent, 1.3–3 cm long; bracts broadly ovate, 3 mm long; pistillate receptacles 7 mm across; umbel rays 1–2 cm long. Staminate perianth 5–6 mm long, oblong in mature bud; outer tepals oblong, obtuse at apex, 1.5 mm wide, inner ones linear, 0.8 mm wide, both reflexed at anthesis. Anthers linear-oblong, 1.3 mm long on 7 mm long exserted filament. Pistillate perianth 4–5 mm long; tepals linear-oblong, ca 1 mm wide. Ovary ovoid; staminodes 3, needle-like. Berries globose to ellipsoid-globose, 9–12 mm in diameter, 1-or 2-seeded, maturing dark red.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax ovalifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 215. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large climber; stems 1–8 m long, terete or obtusely angular, internodes 8–25 cm long, 3–12 mm thick, smooth or with sparse divergent to recurved prickles 2–3 mm long; branches 25–50 cm long, straightish, internodes 2–10 cm long, 1–3 mm thick, smooth, or sometimes loosely prickly. Leaves highly variable in form and size; blades basically ovate to ovate-oval, sometimes elliptic or narrowly so, or ovate-elliptic, rarely broadly elliptic, 7–18 cm long, 2.5–13 cm wide, the base subabruptly contracted or rounded, at times subacute, or rarely shallowly emarginate, gradually or subabruptly tapering from below the middle to acute apex, coriaceous, more or less glaucous; costas 5 or 7 including a weak marginal pair, the median 3 connate for 5–13 mm j above base, thick and highly raised on lower surface, shallowly impressed on upper surface, lateral veinlets patent, straightish or incurved, reticulations rather not elongate, prominent on lower surface; petioles 1.5–4(–6) cm long, 3-angular with subacute abaxial angle, sheathing for 0.8–4 cm; wings broadly ovate, 1.5–2.5 cm long, 0.7–1.2 cm wide, gradually tapering above to subacute apex, the cordate base deeply clasping the node; wings of stem leaves much larger, up to 6 cm long and 2.7 cm wide; tendrils 7–20 cm long. Inflorescences borne on lower and middle part of branches, mostly 1- to 3-umbellate, but in staminate ones occasionally up to 15-umbellate with some umbels 2- to 4-nate at 4 to 6 nodes; common axis usually 1–3 cm long, rarely up to 15 cm long in staminate inflorescences; prophylls ovate, acute, 0.8–1 cm long; peduncles 2–5 cm long, rigid. Umbels of both sexes 3–5 cm across, densely 20- to 70-flower-ed: receptacles ellipsoid, 4–5 mm by 3–4 mm; rays 7–15 mm long, slender. Staminate perianth 5.5–6.2 mm long, strongly recurved at anthesis; outer tepals oblong, obtuse, 1–1.2 mm wide, inner ones linear 0.3 mm wide; filaments 6 mm long; anthers elliptic-oblong, 1.2 mm long, white. Pistillate perianth patent at anthesis, 4–5 mm long; tepals lance-ovate, gradually narrowed to subacute apex, outer ones 1.2 mm wide, inner ones 0.5 mm wide; ovary ellipsoid, 2.2–2.5 mm long, 1 mm across, tapering at both ends; stigmas erect, 1–1.25 mm long; staminodes 3, needle-like, 1.8–2.1 mm long. Berries 1–1.2 cm in diameter, maturing red, 1- or 2-seeded; seeds obovate-orbicular, thickly lenticular, ca 5 mm long and as wide, deep red.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax perfoliata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 229. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Presumably a herbaceous climber, the whole plant becoming blackishwhen dry; stems as a rule unbranched, slender, terete, rigid, smooth, glabrous, somewhat shiny, internodes 4–11 cm long, 1.5–2.7 mm thick. Leaves spaced; blades broadly ovate to broadly ovate-elliptic, 8–14 cm long, 6–8 cm wide, rounded to or truncate or shallowly emarginate at base, narowed from ⅓ above the base to the rather suddenly acute or acuminate apex, herbaceous to thinly coriaceous, strongly glaucous and white-powdery beneath; costas 5 or 7 including a weak marginal pair, all separate from the base, equally spaced, the main 3 median costas markedly elevated on lower surface, lateral veinlets distinct, ascending, irregularly divided forming fine and not elongate reticulations, costas and veinlets fine but conspicuous on upper surface; petioles 25–35 mm long, not articulate, somewhat laterally compressed with acute edges; sheath 1–1.3 cm long, the wings 1–1.5 mm wide with membranous pale margins, minutely or hardly auriculate at apex; tendrils up to 10 cm long, slender. Umbels of both sexes 3–6 cm in diameter, densely 40- to 70-flowered; peduncles slender, wiry, 3–6 cm long; receptacles 3–4 mm across; bracteoles ca 1 mm long, ovate-deltoid, pale; umbel-rays filiform, 1–2 cm long. Staminate perianth 4.5–5 mm long and obovate-oblong in mature buds; tepals reflexed from base at anthesis, outer 3 oblanceolate, obtuse, 4.7–5 mm long, 1.5 mm wide, inner 3 oblanceolate-oblong, obtuse, 4–4.5 mm long, 1–1.2 mm wide. Stamens 6, obliquely ascending; filaments 2–3.5 mm long; anthers clavate, white, 1.5–1.7 mm long. Pistillate flowers not seen. Immature berries subglobose.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax pottingeri. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 245. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Densely branched shrub; stems 80–150 cm tall, 2–4 mm thick at middle, bearing a few remote scales below; branches patent, straight, internodes 7–15 mm long, ca 1 mm thick, not or very rarely sparsely aculeate with short prickles ca 1 mm long, 4-angled with acute wing-like edges. Leaves 2-ranked, almost sessile with the base decurrent to the angles of branches; blades rhombic-ovate or broadly ovate, (1.2–)2–5 cm long, (0.7–)1.2–3 cm wide, cuneate at base, narrowed from about above the base to briefly acute apex, herbaceous, costas 3, all separate from the base, faint on upper surface, slender but distinct on lower surface, lateral veinlets relatively few, oblique, reticulations not prominent. Umbels borne on upper part of branches, staminate umbels 5- to 10-flowered, on capillary peduncle 7–12 mm long, the rays 5–8 mm long; pistillate umbels few-flowered, on short peduncles less than 1 cm long, the rays 5–8 mm long; receptacles hardly thickened; bracteoles setaceous, 1 mm long. Staminate perianth yellowish-green, campanulate to spreading, 2.5–3 mm across; outer and inner tepals alike, lance-ovate, gradually subacute at apex, 1.5–1.8 mm long, 0.6–0.75 mm wide. Stamens 6; filaments ca 0.5 mm long; anthers nearly globose, 0.2 mm long, white. Pistillate perianth similar to staminate but slightly smaller; ovary globose 2 mm long; staminodes 3, 1–1.5 mm long, needle-like. Berries 1 to 3 to an umbel, 5–7 mm across, 1– or 2-seeded, deep red at maturity.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax rigida myrtillus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 238. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large climber: stems stout, 2–8 m long, internodes terete, striate,lightly green, 7–20 cm long, 5–10 mm thick, glabrous, rather sparingly beset with short divergent or recurved prickles 1–3 mm long; branches 20–60 cm long, internodes 3–10 cm long, 2–4 mm thick, terete, sparsely prickly, lightly green. Leaves elliptic to narrowly elliptic, rarely ovate-elliptic, 6–20 cm long, 3–12 cm wide, suddenly contracted or rounded at base, rounded or shallowly emarginate at usually mucronate apex, thickly herbaceous to subcoriaceous, light-green on upper surface, pale beneath; costas 5 including a weak marginal pair, the main 3 costas united for 5–10 mm above base, thick, highly convexed on lower surface, impressed on upper surface, lateral veinlets obliquely ascending, straightish, reticulations fine, not elongate, conspicuous on both surfaces; petioles 15–30 mm long, trigonous with subacute abaxial angle, at times tinged with red-brown, sheathing for 0.7–2.5 cm; wings broadly ovate, 0.5–1.2 cm wide, herbaceous and soon withering, brownish or reddish-brown, obtuse at apex, the rounded base hardly clasping the internodes; tendrils 7–20 cm long, often absent on flowering branches. Inflorescences borne on branches and distal part of stem, both sexes with 7 to 25 umbels; common axis prophyllate at base, 8–20 cm long, 3- to 5- nodose, internodes 1–5 cm long: prophyll broadly ovate, 5–7 mm long, acute-tipped. Umbels 2- to 5-nate, 1.5–3 cm across, 18- to 40-flowered; receptacles 2–3 mm across; peduncles 1–4 cm long, spreading. Staminate perianth 4–5 mm long, yellow or yellow-green, strongly recurved at anthesis; outer tepals oblong, 1–1.3 mm wide, obtuse at apex, inner ones linear, obtuse, 0.3–0.5 mm wide; filaments 4–4.5 mm long; anthers oblong, recurved, 1.5 mm long, white. Pistillate perianth 3–4 mm long, recurved at anthesis; tepals lance-oblong, subacute at apex, outer ones 0.8–1.2 mm wide, inner ones 0.5 mm wide. Ovary subglobose, 1 mm long and as wide; stigmas 0.8–1 mm long; staminodes 3, needle-like, only 0.5 mm long. Berries unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax siamensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 228. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Suberect shrub to scandent vine 30–200 cm tall, somewhat tufted atbase; stems, simple to rather densely branched, straightish, young ones deeply glaucous, subterete, finely striate, smooth or with sparse fine prickles ca 1 mm long, internodes 2–10 cm long, 1.5–3 mm thick. Leaves highly variable in shape; blades on young stems ovate-oblong to ovate-elliptic, sometimes lance-oblong or elliptic, those on old stems ovate-oval to oval or obovate-oval, cuneate to abruptly contracted to the base, occasionally shallowly emarginate, attenuate to obtuse or acute apex, (5–)10–15(–18) cm long, (2–)4–10 cm wide, herbaceous, fresh green above, glaucous and white-powdery beneath, costas 5 or 7 including a marginal pair, the median 3 united to 5–7 cm above the base, raised with sharp edge on lower surface, fine but distinct on upper surface, lateral veinlets obliquely ascending, distinct on both surfaces, further divided, forming relatively loose, obliquely elongate reticulations; petioles 10–20 mm long, weakly incurved, laterally compressed with sharp dorsal edge, sheathing for 3 to 5 mm; wings narrow (ca 0.5 mm), membranous; tendrils none or short, rarely up to 7 cm long on distal part of branches. Inflorescences with 1 or 2 umbels on upper branches; inflorescence axis short (3–5 mm), mostly enclosed in the leaf sheath; prophylls at base of common axis ovate, acuminate, 5–7 mm long; peduncles 1–2 cm long, rather stout. Staminate umbels densely 15- to 40-flowered; pistillate umbels 10- to 17-flowered; receptacles ellipsoid, 4–5 mm long, 2 mm thick. Staminate perianth recurved on upper half; outer tepals oblong, obtuse, 3–4 mm long, 1–1.5 mm wide; inner tepals linear, obtuse, 2–2.5 mm long, 0.5 mm wide. Stamens exserted; filaments 2.5–3 mm long; anthers oblong, 0.7–1 mm long. Pistillate perianth patent; outer tepals lanceolate, 3–3.5 mm long, 0.5 mm wide, acute. Ovary ovoid, 3 mm long, 1.2–1.5 mm across; stigmas 0.7–1 mm long; staminodes 3, needle-like, 1.2–1.5 mm long. Berries 0.8 mm in diameter, maturing reddish, 1- or 2-seeded.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax verticalis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 223. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber to 4 m long, with relatively slender stems; flowering branches more or less straight, 30–50 cm long, 2–3 mm thick, terete, hardly striate, somewhat shiny, smooth or very sparsely aculeate, the internodes 2–8 cm long. Leaves not highly variable in shape; blades broadly elliptic or ovate-orbicular, 6–13 cm long, 3–10 cm wide, rounded-truncate or suddenly contracted at base, rounded or contracted above to short-acuminate apex, thickly herbaceous to subcoriaceous; costas 5, all divided to base, the median 3 markedly convex on lower surface, lateral veinlets obliquely ascending, line but distinct on both surfaces, the reticulations more or less obliquely elongate; petioles 15–30 mm long, 2–3 mm thick, subterete; sheath 7–10 mm long; wings 1–1.5 mm wide, thinly herbaceous, the apices ending in a narrowly deltoid auricle 2–3 mm long; tendrils on vegetative leaves 10–20 cm long, those on flowering leaves vestigial or wanting. Inflorescences reduced to a single umbel, the common axis very short (0.3–1 cm), bearing 2 bracts at apex; prophyll ovate, acute, 5–6 mm long; peduncle 2.5–4 cm long; bracts ovale, 4–5 mm long. Staminate umbels ca 3 cm across, densely 50- to 70-flowered; receptacle oblong-ellipsoid, 3–6 mm long; rays filiform, ca 1 cm long. Pistillate umbels 2.5–3 cm across, 25- to 40-flowered; receptacle oblong, 5 mm long; rays 8–10 mm long. Staminate perianth 5–5.5 mm long, white; outer tepals oblanceolate-oblong, 1 mm wide, obtuse, inner ones narrowly lanceolate, 0.8 mm wide. Umbels oblong, 0.8 mm long; filaments 6 mm long. Pistillate perianth 4–4.5 mm long, white; outer tepals elliptic, 1.7 mm wide, rounded, inner ones lanceolate 0.7 mm wide. Ovary ovoid, 3 mm long. Staminodes 3, needle-like, 2 mm long. Berries globose, 7–9 mm in diameter, dirty yellow.
bibliographicCitation: Smilax zeylanica hemsleyana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 218. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual herb with more or less fleshy, hollow stem up to 1 m high. Leaves spirally arranged, lanceolate, glabrous, up to 10 cm long and 4 cm broad with a short to 3 cm long petiole. Inflorescences a dense spike, 4–7 cm long; bracts and bracteoles ± spathulate. Calyx spherical with 5 oval sepals. Corolla white, campanulate with a short tube, and 5 lobes, 3–4 mm long. Stamens 5, inserted on the corolla tube. Ovary obovoid, inferior, bilocular, with numerous ovules; style short, bilobed. Capsule dehiscing below the calyx-segments by a lid.
bibliographicCitation: Sphenoclea zeylanica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 280. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual herb 5–12 cm high with a short stem with 2–3 leaves, terminatedby a rosette of larger, spathulate leaves, 12–20 mm long. Inflorescences cymose, terminal, 1–5 few-flowered scapes; bracts minute. Calyx 5-merous, bilabiate, 1–2 mm. Corolla pink, 5 mm, with very short tube; labellum short, subulate; 2 lateral lobes obtuse-emarginate, the 2 posterior slightly longer, obliquely truncate, rarely emarginate. Column long, exserted, geniculate, 4–6 mm. Ovary 10 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Stylidium kunthii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 276. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Erect annual herb 5–10 cm high (rarely more). Stem simple or sparselybranched. Leaves scattered, sessile, obovate-lanceolate; the lower ones up to 10 mm long, with a tendency to form a rosette, gradually diminishing; in the inflorescence appearing as tiny, linear bracts. Inflorescences composed of 2–8 sessile flowers. Calyx 5-merous, bilabiate, 2–3 mm. Corolla white-pink with a 1 mm long tube; lobes 5, the anterior lobe (labellum) very short subulate, the 2 lateral ones lanceolate, ca 1.5 mm, the 2 posterior 3 mm long, bifid; a row of minute appendages inserted in the corolla throat. Column exserted, geniculate 5–6 mm. Ovary 10–15 mm long. Capsule linear up to 2 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Stylidium tenellum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 274. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Stemless annual herb 5–15 cm high with numerous scapes from a smallrosette. Leaves appressed to the soil, glabrous, oblong-suborbicular with a short petiole, 5–10 mm long. The lower half of the scapes leafless. Inflorescence cymose with 5–15 sessile flowers. Calyx 5-merous, bilabiate, 1–2 mm. Corolla white with a 1 mm long tube; labellum short, subulate; the 4 other lobes ca 4 mm, the 2 posterior bilobed. Column exserted, geniculate, 7 mm long. Ovary 15 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Stylidium uliginosum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 276. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree, 6–8 m tall. Leaves thin coriaceous, obovate-elliptic, 24–32 by 10–12 cm; apex broadly acute or obtuse; base cuneate; lateral veins 12–18 pairs, slightly raised below; glabrescent on both surfaces; midrib thinly villous; margin flat or wavy; petiole 2.5–3.5 cm long, pulvinate at the base. Flower-buds ovoid, 4.5–5 by 3–3.2 cm; spathaceous bract verrucose and scattered with brown hairs; peduncle stout, 2.5–4 cm long. Tepals white. Stamens 1.2–1.5 cm long. Gynoecium ellipsoid, 1.8–2 by 1–1.2 cm; carpels numerous (80–100), densely covered with short, brownish hairs, or glabrous. Fruiting carpels in an ellipsoid or broad ovoid mass, 8–10 by 5.5–7.5 cm, eventually disintegrating; individual carpels narrowly rhomboid, 2.5–4 cm long, lenticellate.
bibliographicCitation: Talauma betongensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 3, 1975. Pg. 258. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, to 10 m tall. Leaves thin-coriaceous, narrowly oblong to ovate-oblong, 7–15 by 4–6 cm; apex abruptly acute or obliquely caudate; base acute or obtuse; lateral veins 10–12 pairs, strongly impressed below; petiole 1.5–2 cm long, sericeous, pulvinate at the base. Flower-buds narrowly ellipsoid, 3–3.5 by 1.8–2 cm; spathaceous bracts thinly villous; peduncle 1–1.5 cm long. Tepals greenish-white; outer ones 3 by 1.5 cm; inner ones much narrower. description: Small to medium-sized tree, 10–15 m tall. Leaves thin-coriaceous, narrowly obovate or narrowly elliptic, 19–45 by 6.5–12(–16) cm; apex acute or obtuse; base narrowly cuneate: lateral veins 9–12(–20) pairs, raised beneath; glabrous on both surfaces, except the midrib which is adpressed hairy; margin flat or wavy; petiole 4.5–5.5(–8.5) cm long, glabrous or verrucose, pulvinate at the base. Flower-buds subglobose, 3–4 cm across; spathaceous bract purple; peduncle stout, 1.5–2 cm long. Tepals creamy white, thick and succulent, outer ones 5–7 by 2.5–4 cm; inner ones narrower. Stamens 1.5–2 cm long, the connective shortly produced. Gynoecium ovoid or top-shaped, glabrous. Fruiting carpels forming an ovoid or ellipsoid mass, 10–15 by 3.5–5 cm: individual carpels 2.5 cm long.

description: Small to medium-sized tree, 8–15 m tall. Flower-buds ovoid, 3.5–4 by 2–2.5 cm; spathaceous bracts very thick, hairy and verrucose externally. Tepals creamy white, rather thick outer ones 3.5–5 by 1–1.5 cm; inner ones smaller and narrower. Gynoecium top-shaped; carpels 7–17, ovoid, beaked, glabrous. Fruiting carpels in an ovoid mass, 6–7 by 4–4.5 cm; seeds pinkish.

description: Erect, herb up to ca 1 m. Leaves elliptic to obovate, up to 15 by 5 cm, acute to acuminate; nervation pinnate.
